capabilities: Render graphs of relationships declared in note frontmatter properties
Embed per-note relationship graphs in notes and callouts with configurable size, depth, and scope
Draw generation-aligned family-tree and family-graph genealogy layouts
Filter individual graphs by relationship type, group, and tag
Lock and save dragged node positions per graph block
disambiguation: Not a whole-vault link graph; it draws only relationships you have explicitly declared in frontmatter properties, typed and filtered.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README recommends installing via BRAT. A legacy npc-graph code-block alias is supported for notes made before the plugin was renamed.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph shows every link in the vault at once and undifferentiated, with no way to display named, typed relationships such as ally, spouse, or parent.

relations.evidence: Built on Cytoscape.js for graph rendering, with fcose for force-directed layouts and dagre for top-down trees.

summary: Typed relationship graph that visualises explicitly declared frontmatter connections between notes, with portraits, family-tree layouts, and embeddable graphs.
